title: CDK4/6 inhibition overcomes venetoclax resistance mechanisms with enhanced combination activity in acute myeloid leukemia
model: OCI-AML2 AML cells, genome-wide knockout (5 guides/gene)
contrast: Palbociclib, venetoclax and combination vs DMSO (2 vs 2 each)
paper_method: Guide-level edgeR-style tests, gene tiers by guide FDR
paper_calls: Ven: BAX, PMAIP1; palbo: RB1, HNRNPU, CEBPE; combo: IKZF1
barcs_calls: Palbo 1,525, ven 92 enriched, combo 87 enriched genes at FDR 0.10
named_hits: BAX ven #3 (FDR 3e-4); RB1 palbo FDR 0.03; HNRNPU #4, CEBPE #6; IKZF1 combo FDR 0.051
verdict: BARCS 0.2.1 recovers every resistance gene the paper names. The venetoclax and combination libraries collapsed onto a few clones, so only enrichment is interpretable there, and the Wald test missed BAX (p = 0.79) until the likelihood-ratio test was added.
